name: BACH_0119
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (95%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, high reliability and second-model agreement all support Benign [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 95%, Normal 5% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 36th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Benign, 4 Normal | Neighbors lean Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Largest negative concept term; failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 4, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; spot check 20/20 · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Modest score, one region only · Validated
- **Neoplastic nuclei** (region 11) · context · 15 of 51 nuclei neoplastic; regions 0 and 8 have one each · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier; the lead concept, normal lobules, is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Four of five similar cases are Normal; the Benign–Normal boundary may be softer than 95% implies.
- Nuclei were segmented in only 3 regions, and the sample was flagged insufficient for tumor nuclei.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11** — Assess whether the neoplastic cells infiltrate stroma.
2. **Regions 0, 7, 8** — Confirm normal lobules; the AI spot check failed.
3. **Region 8** — Review nuclear pleomorphism, the highest-scoring region.
